# YouthAtlas

> YouthAtlas is an AI-powered platform that helps young people discover scholarships, fellowships, internships, grants, conferences, competitions, training programs, and jobs worldwide.

## Content

- /opportunities — Browse all opportunities with filters (type, region, funding)
- /scholarships — Scholarships for students
- /fellowships — Fellowship opportunities
- /grants — Grants for students and researchers
- /internships — Internships at international organizations
- /conferences — Student and youth conferences
- /competitions — Competitions, hackathons, and awards
- /training — Training programs and bootcamps
- /jobs — Entry-level jobs and graduate programs

Each type page has regional sub-pages (e.g. /scholarships/africa, /fellowships/europe) and a fully-funded filter (e.g. /scholarships/fully-funded).

## Regions Covered

Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America, North America, Middle East, Oceania, Global

## Data

Opportunities are updated daily. Each listing includes: title, organization, type, deadline, regions, target audience, funding details, description, and application link.

## Contact
